description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to extract the exact GPT Analyzer logic. (2) For each of the 5 submission text files, replicate the full analyzeGPTContent algorithm: iterate through all GPT-4 phrases (+0.2 each), GPT-3.5 phrases (+0.2 each), and common phrases (+0.1 each) against the lowercased text; compute structureScore (0.15 if >=3 numbered list lines OR >=3 bullet lines using \n\d+\. and \n[•\-\*] regex patterns, else 0); compute sentence variance and uniformityScore (0.1 if variance < 500); cap totalScore at 1.0; set confidence = Math.round(capped * 100) as integer; set detectedModel based on which score is highest (gpt-4 vs gpt-3.5 vs gpt-family), but override to 'not-gpt' if isGPT is false (minConfidence=0.7); set recommendation using the exact 4-tier threshold strings. (3) Write all 5 results to analysis_report.json. Key proprietary traps: the asymmetric scoring (0.2 vs 0.1), the variance < 500 threshold for uniformity, the 'not-gpt' override on detectedModel, and the exact recommendation strings.
